Goal: Refugees and vulnerable host communities in Uganda, especially women and youth, have increased access and utilization of clean, reliable, and affordable energy products and services, thus sustainably increasing their overall standard of living, health, and livelihoods.
5000 households, refugees (50% women) and surrounding host communities (70:30 split, also 50% women22) over 12 months.

Outcome 1: Increased demand and uptake of off-grid solar (OGS) technologies [including productive use of energy (PUE) technologies, and clean cooking solutions CCS) aligned with the SOLCO Partnership] among households and enterprises in refugee-hosting areas
